statement: A separately-authorized governed act's eligibility (e.g. 'may this specific artifact be frozen right now') must be derived directly from that act's own authoritative state (the artifact's own lifecycle + the operator's own recorded authorization) — never gated behind the success or completion of an unrelated, slower, multi-signal composition (e.g. a whole workflow's stage-projection read) that answers a DIFFERENT question. A slow or degraded broader projection is allowed to say honestly 'this composite view is stale/incomplete'; it must never be allowed to hide, by construction, an independently-ready act that does not depend on it. Practically: render/derive the governed act from its own fast, narrow read; never thread a slower composition's output (or its own loading/error state) into the gate that decides whether the act is offered.
